onTimeStopCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM stops WHERE on_time

lateStopCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM stops WHERE NOT on_time

stopOnTimeRateByVersion.sql: SELECT t.route_version, 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.on_time)/count(*) FROM stops s JOIN trips t ON t.id=s.trip_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

damagedStopCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM stops WHERE damaged_boxes >= 1

tempExcursionStopCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM stops WHERE temp_excursion

alarmStopCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM stops WHERE alarm_triggered

understaffedStopCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM stops WHERE handler_days_worked <= 3

fullyOnTimeTripCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE late_stop_count = 0

tripFullyOnTimeRateByVersion.sql: SELECT route_version, 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE late_stop_count=0)/count(*) FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

tripFullyOnTimeRateByWeek.sql: SELECT to_char(trip_date,'IYYY-"W"IW') w, 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE late_stop_count=0)/count(*) FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

lateStopCountByWeek.sql: SELECT to_char(trip_date,'IYYY-"W"IW') w, sum(late_stop_count) FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

overStationTripCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE actual_stops > 15

stopsPerTrip.note: 实际站数，不是计划站数

stopsPerTripByVersion.sql: SELECT route_version, avg(actual_stops) FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

overloadedTripWeightCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE load_weight > weight_capacity_snapshot

axleOverloadTripCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE axle_overload

axleOverloadRateByVersion.sql: SELECT route_version, 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE axle_overload)/count(*) FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

completedTripCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE stops_delivered = actual_stops

scheduledDriverDayCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM driver_schedule WHERE scheduled

attendedDriverDayCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM driver_schedule WHERE status='attended'

driverAttendanceRate.sql: SELECT 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='attended')/count(*) FROM driver_schedule WHERE scheduled

attendanceByReasonMix.sql: SELECT coalesce(reason,'未填'), count(*) FROM driver_schedule WHERE scheduled AND status<>'attended' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

tripsPerAttendedDriverDay.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM trips)::numeric / (SELECT count(*) FROM driver_schedule WHERE status='attended')

deliveredStopsPerAttendedDriverDay.sql: SELECT (SELECT sum(stops_delivered) FROM trips)::numeric / (SELECT count(*) FROM driver_schedule WHERE status='attended')

nonForceMajeureTicketCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM incident_tickets WHERE responsible_party <> '不可抗力'

anomalyTripRate.sql: SELECT 100.0*(SELECT count(*) FROM incident_tickets WHERE responsible_party<>'不可抗力')/(SELECT count(*) FROM trips)

anomalyTypeMix.sql: SELECT type, count(*) FROM incident_tickets GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

unjudgedComplaintCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM complaints WHERE liability IS NULL

unjudgedComplaintRate.sql: SELECT 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE liability IS NULL)/count(*) FROM complaints

complaintPerTrip.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM complaints)::numeric/(SELECT count(*) FROM trips)

unreasonedRefusalCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM refusals WHERE reason IS NULL

unreasonedRefusalRate.sql: SELECT 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE reason IS NULL)/count(*) FROM refusals

refusalReasonMix.sql: SELECT coalesce(reason,'未填'), count(*) FROM refusals GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

adoptedDecisionCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dispatch_decisions WHERE adopted

forbiddenZoneViolationCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM violations WHERE category='闯禁行'

violationRatePer10kKm.sql: SELECT 10000.0*(SELECT count(*) FROM violations WHERE category='闯禁行')/(SELECT sum(actual_km) FROM trips)

violationTypeMix.sql: SELECT category, count(*) FROM violations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

coreZoneTripCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE core_restricted

coreZoneNoPermitTripCount.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE core_restricted AND NOT permit_valid

coreZoneNoPermitTripRate.sql: SELECT 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT permit_valid)/count(*) FROM trips WHERE core_restricted

operatingCostPerKm.note: 运营口径（不含固定成本）

costOtherNullRows.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trip_costs WHERE other_cost IS NULL

fuelPer100km.note: S5 样例第4条的第二路线

attendanceRate.sql: SELECT 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='attended')/count(*) FROM driver_schedule WHERE scheduled
attendanceRate.note: S5 样例第5条的第二路线（2894/5036）

_doc_defs: 第二条路线：每个定义的手写 SQL 谓词，故意写成与 TTL 里 :physicalPredicate 不同的措辞（NOT on_time 而不是 on_time = FALSE；actual_stops >= 16 而不是 > 15；NOT (amount IS NULL) 而不是 amount IS NOT NULL），这样 check_ontology_generic 的 R2 才是「两套写法各自落到同一批行」，而不是把同一句话抄两遍。表的写法是物理表名，谓词只用该表自己的列。
